## Recovered observations

130 points (from FA-26) read by two readings made separately and reconciled (batch `curves-appa-b2`, rules `docs/CURVE-READING.md (2026-10-08)`). Values are SI; the printed-unit values and the pixel coordinates on the page image are kept beside them so every point can be checked against the scan. x_read_bound and y_read_bound are reading bounds in printed units: the largest change of value over the point's pixel interval on the piecewise map, plus the location error of the two lines around it (D-025; the global calibration residual is not added, see qa/<batch>/calibration-sensitivity.md for the affine difference); x_bound_si and y_bound_si are the same in SI. They are not standard deviations.

Both readings drawn on the page image (filled circles: Claude's reading; hollow squares: Codex's; bars: pixel bounds; the canonical reading of each panel is named in the batch review). Click to enlarge.

## Notes from the two readings

- Claude: Inset D50 0.42 mm (0.40-0.43); D10 0.28 mm (0.27-0.29); Cu 1.5; D95 0.6 mm (0.58-0.62). Reprinted under soils 8 and 9 (FA-30; FA-34). Table 2-3 prints mean 0.4; Cu 1.3; D95 0.52. No unused statement in the SS text.
- Codex: Five samples; individual sample identities missing. Also specifications 8 and 9. AM-68-1 Vol. II, Fig. A-26, printed A-53, PDF 54
